read.title: Read
read.subtitle: Only confirmed chapters are shown. To change the wording, use the writing page.
read.empty: No confirmed chapters yet. After you confirm one, you can read on here, volume by volume.
read.emptyChapter: This chapter was confirmed with no text.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Text, summaries, outline, character cards, setting cards, and foreshadows
search.placeholder: A sentence, a name, or a foreshadow
search.prompt: Type a word to search this book.

stats.title: Stats
stats.missLatest: Latest test run · the one that matters
stats.editHint: Share of generated words that were changed
stats.anomalyNone: Dark bars mean a chapter was regenerated more than twice. None right now.
stats.anomalySome: Dark bars mean regenerated more than twice: {list}
stats.emptyLead: The test set measures how many mistakes the consistency check misses. You can
stats.labelContext: Known facts (treated as memory during the check)
stats.labelExpected: Buried mistakes (caught if the keyword shows up in the check)
stats.notePh: Note, for example: a dead character appears

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Confirming a chapter, or letting AI edit the outline or a card, leaves a version.
versions.empty: No versions yet. A record appears here after a chapter is confirmed.
versions.pick: Select a version on the left to see what changed.
versions.noMemory: This confirmation did not change the memory.
versions.assistBody: After undoing “{label}”, the outline, chapter outlines, and cards changed this time go back. Chapters, volumes, and cards created then are deleted. Whether a chapter is confirmed, and its text, stay as they are.
versions.confirmBody: After undoing “{label}”: {count} cards return to how they were before chapter {number} was confirmed, and cards and foreshadows added this time are deleted. The text of chapter {number} stays. The chapter goes back to unconfirmed, so you can confirm it again.
versions.later: A later version is still in place. Undo the newest one first.
versions.restorePrompt: Restore “{name}” to how it was before chapter {number} was confirmed? Other cards stay as they are.

chat.heading: Chat with AI
chat.fallback: No model is selected for “Chat with AI”, so the “Generate text” model is being used for now.
chat.noModel: No usable model yet. Choose one for “Chat with AI” or “Generate text”.
chat.empty: Say what you want to change. If a field is still empty, you can also click “Fill with AI”.
chat.createBook: Create a book from this plan
chat.placeholder: Say how you want it changed. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.stopped: Stopped. The reply from the model will still be saved.

chapter.head: Chapter {number} · {title}
chapter.savedTitle: Memory updated, and the version was saved
chapter.summaryMissing: The summary has not been generated
chapter.cannotRevert: You can’t undo this chapter while a later chapter is confirmed
chapter.confirmedOnly: Only confirmed chapters can be exported
chapter.formatBody: ☑ Markdown marks are removed, and each paragraph is indented two spaces
chapter.merge: Merge into one file (otherwise several chapters are zipped, one file each)
chapter.undoBody: puts {count} cards back to the version from before confirmation, keeps the text, and returns the chapter to “checked”. You can’t undo this chapter alone while a later chapter is confirmed.
chapter.revertPrompt: After undoing “{label}”: {count} cards go back to how they were before confirmation, the text of chapter {number} stays, and the chapter returns to “checked” so you can confirm it again.

sidebar.title: Chapters
sidebar.empty: No chapters yet. Click “New chapter”, or write a chapter outline on the Outline page.

confirm.head: Chapter {number} · {title}
confirm.title: Confirm memory changes
confirm.extracting: Extracting memory changes from this chapter…
confirm.skipModel: Skip the model and only record who appears
confirm.shortcuts: Shortcuts: A accept · E edit · R reject
confirm.noneManual: Nothing in this chapter needs a manual decision
confirm.keyNoteLead: Death, leaving the scene, and power level changes
confirm.keyNoteRest: are not accepted automatically. Death and leaving are asked about again before you accept them.
confirm.foot: Confirming updates {count} cards, writes the summary for chapter {number}, and saves a version you can roll back.
confirm.acceptPrompt: Change the {field} of {name} to “{value}”? If they appear in a later chapter, the check will flag it as “Must fix”.
confirm.saved: Memory updated, and the version was saved

context.intro: When this chapter is generated, the text model receives everything below. If the chapter goes off the rails, check whether something here was left out.
context.settingsEmpty: None (a setting is included only if the outline names it, or it is pinned)
context.summariesEmpty: None (a summary is written when a chapter is confirmed)
context.goalEmpty: (Empty. You can add it on the Outline page.)

issues.never2: When the text is ready, run a consistency check.
issues.never3: It compares the chapter with memory for voice, setting, dead characters appearing, and similar problems.
issues.checked: Checked at {time} · after an edit, check again before confirming
issues.dirty: The text changed after the check. Check again before confirming.
issues.fpFolded: {count} more marked as false positives, folded
issues.fpOpen: {count} more marked as false positives, hide
issues.notePh: A note, for example: the repetition shows he is nervous
issues.suppress: Don’t flag this kind of issue again in this chapter

reasons.stale: The memory is out of date

outlineForm.title: Chapter title
outlineForm.goalPh: What this chapter needs to do
outlineForm.payoffPh: The moment the reader enjoys most
outlineForm.hookPh: A question that makes the reader want the next chapter
outlineForm.noCardSimilar: “{name}” has no character card. Did you mean “{similar}”?
outlineForm.linksHint: These foreshadows are included when generating. Ones due to pay off soon are included too.
outlineForm.created: Created character card “{name}”. Fill in the rest on the Memory page.
